01Customer Support

Nexa Support

Intelligent e-commerce support that proves its value.

An AI support system that answers product and policy questions with cited sources, looks up orders, drafts policy-correct refund decisions, and escalates sensitive cases to humans. Every metric is computed from real ticket replays.

  • Grounded answers with source citations
  • Order lookup and status assistance
  • Policy-correct refund and return decisions
  • Human escalation for sensitive cases
  • Operations dashboard with real ROI metrics

Nexa Order Intelligence

An agentic system for order and shipping workflows.

A ReAct AI agent that handles order lookups, shipment tracking, and returns through tool execution and structured API interactions — not just chat.

  • Order lookup by ID or email
  • Shipment tracking across carriers
